calc_concentracao.title: Spray Mixture Concentration Calculator
calc_concentracao.content:
[FAQ: What is the purpose of the Concentration Calculator?]
- Calculates the exact amount of pesticide to dilute per tank for Young Crop or Adult Canopy based on authorized DGAV label dosage.

[FAQ: What is Young Crop Mode?]
- Takes into account the target volume to prepare and recommended label concentration for early-stage crops.

[FAQ: What is Adult Canopy Mode?]
- Adjusts the calculation by integrating the recommended spray volume per hectare and actual volume applied by equipment.
calc_concentracao.unit_explanation:
Q_p : Pesticide Quantity (mL or g)
Volume : Liters (L)
Concentration : Percentage (%)

calc_dose.title: Dose Per Hectare Calculator
calc_dose.content:
[FAQ: What is the function of this calculator?]
- Converts label dose (L/ha or kg/ha) into exact product amount per tank based on calibrated spray volume.

[FAQ: How to calculate area covered per full tank?]
- Divide tank capacity by actual spray volume per hectare. Example: 1,000 L / 200 L/ha = 5.0 hectares per tank.
calc_dose.formula:
Q_p = (C_d × D × 1,000) / V_a
Area (ha) = C_d / V_a
calc_dose.unit_explanation:
Q_p : Product Quantity in Tank (mL or g)
C_d : Volume to Prepare (L)
D : Label Dose (L/ha or kg/ha)
V_a : Applied Volume (L/ha)

perfil_cultura.title: Crop Profile & Canopy Geometry
perfil_cultura.content:
[FAQ: Why record crop details?]
- Recording crop variety, phenological stage, and row spacing allows precise spray volume calculation and TRV adjustments.

[FAQ: What is Leaf Area Index (LAI)?]
- It is the ratio of total upper leaf surface area to ground surface area.
perfil_cultura.unit_explanation:
W_w : Row Spacing (m)
W : Canopy Width (m)
H : Canopy Height (m)

perfil_equipamento.title: Spraying Equipment Profile
perfil_equipamento.content:
[FAQ: Why record sprayer details?]
- Allows management of pump, filter, regulator, and tank specifications for ISO 16122 calibration tests.
perfil_equipamento.formula: Pump Flow Rate ≥ Total Flow Q_t + Agitation (≥5%)

perfil_bicos.title: Sprayer Nozzles Profile
perfil_bicos.content:
[FAQ: How does ISO nozzle classification work?]
- Nozzle color defines nominal flow rate at 3 bar pressure according to ISO 10625 standard.

[FAQ: Why does nozzle type matter?]
- Air-induction nozzles drastically reduce drift on windy days.
perfil_bicos.unit_explanation:
Q_nozzle : Nozzle Flow Rate (L/min)
Angle : Spray Angle (60°, 80°, 110°)

perfil_calibracao.title: Calibration Profile & Field Test
perfil_calibracao.content:
[FAQ: What is a calibration test?]
- A field test using clean water to determine real ground speed, nozzle flow rate, and spray volume applied per hectare.
perfil_calibracao.unit_explanation:
v : Speed (km/h)
Q_t : Total Flow Rate (L/min)
W_w : Working Width (m)

preferencias_unidades.title: Measurement Units & Standard Profiles
preferencias_unidades.content:
[FAQ: How do Unit Profiles work?]
- Allow switching between Metric (SI), US Customary, Anglo-Saxon, and Traditional Regional systems without losing hydraulic calculation precision.
preferencias_unidades.formula: Automatic conversion across DATERRA Smart ecosystem
preferencias_unidades.unit_explanation:
SI : L, ha, bar, km/h
US : gal, acre, psi, mph
